_comment: full simulated support of the element; chosen for reproducibility, not the supervisor's ROIs
_note: Each ROI spans one element's full simulated support, computed from the
element-spectrum export. The supervisor's ROIs are deliberately not used:
he counted MEASURED counts, while the program integrates SIMULATED partial
counts, so VALIDATION B compares two different methods and can never be an
equality test. Full support is the reproducible, self-documenting choice.
Channel numbering: .xnra and the metadata export share one axis (channel
N == channel N, export omits channel 0). Do not include channel 0; see
_layers_note: xnra layers 2-6 are the ZrOx film = xlsx L1-L5. xnra L1 (C cap), L7 (SiO2), L8 (Si substrate) have no xlsx counterpart.
